mapper.select: SELECT APPLICANT_RECORD_NO , RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO , APPLICANT_ID , RECRUIT_PROCESS_STEP , STEP_PASS_YN , STEP_APPLICATION_YN FROM APPLICANT_RECORD

SELECT APPLICANT_RECORD_NO , RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO , APPLICANT_ID , STEP_PASS_YN , STEP_APPLICATION_YN , INTERVIEW_URL , EVALUATION_START_TIME , APPLICANT_NAME FROM APPLICANT_RECORD WHERE APPLICANT_RECORD_NO = #{applicantRecordNo}

WITH exam_cte (ex_applicant_id, ex_score, ex_rn) AS ( SELECT APPLICANT_ID, APPLICANT_SCORE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY APPLICANT_ID ORDER BY APPLICANT_ID) FROM APPLICANT_ANSWER ), interview_cte (int_applicant_id, int_score, int_rn) AS ( SELECT iscore.APPLICANT_ID, iscore.APPLICANT_RATING, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY iscore.APPLICANT_ID ORDER BY iscore.APPLICANT_ID) FROM INTERVIEW_SCORE iscore JOIN INTERVIEW i ON iscore.INTERVIEW_NO = i.INTERVIEW_NO ) SELECT rp.RECRUITMENT_NO AS recruitment_no, rp.RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO AS process_no, rp.RECRUIT_PROCESS_STEP AS step, rp.RECRUIT_PROCESS_TYPE AS step_type, rp.RECRUIT_PROCESS_FINAL as final, ar.APPLICANT_ID AS applicant_id, ar.APPLICANT_NAME AS applicant_name, ar.STEP_APPLICATION_YN AS attend, ar.STEP_PASS_YN AS pass, ap.USER_ID as userid, exam_cte.ex_score AS exam_score, interview_cte.int_score AS interview_score FROM RECRUIT_PROCESS rp LEFT JOIN APPLICANT_RECORD ar ON rp.RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO = ar.RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO LEFT JOIN APPLICANT ap ON ap.APPLICANT_ID = ar.APPLICANT_ID LEFT JOIN exam_cte ON ar.APPLICANT_ID = exam_cte.ex_applicant_id AND exam_cte.ex_rn = 1 LEFT JOIN interview_cte ON ar.APPLICANT_ID = interview_cte.int_applicant_id AND interview_cte.int_rn = 1 WHERE rp.RECRUITMENT_NO = #{recruitmentNo} ORDER BY step, applicant_id

SELECT APPLICANT_RECORD_NO , RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO , APPLICANT_ID , STEP_PASS_YN , STEP_APPLICATION_YN , INTERVIEW_URL , EVALUATION_START_TIME , APPLICANT_NAME FROM APPLICANT_RECORD WHERE APPLICANT_ID = #{applicantId} AND RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO = #{recruitProcessNo}
